title: AI × Math 每日精选
subtitle: 自动推理、形式化证明、数学智能与基础模型。
method: 公开来源采集、历史去重、规则筛选与模型审阅
method_note: 系统保存当日公开元数据，与历史日报核验后排除已报道事件；论文新版本、新修订及不同软件发布等可核实更新仍可入选，随后由指定模型阅读全文摘要并完成精选。

items.title: Learning to Prove, Not Just to Answer: Reinforcement Learning from Formal Verification for Natural-Language Logical Reasoning
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed for natural-language logical reasoning, where the final answer is easy to check but the proof behind it is not. In natural-language logical reasoning, an intermediate conclusion should follow from its premises, and the resulting derivation should support the final answer. Existing methods lack machine-checkable verification of intermediate conclusions and answer-supporting proof dependencies, so they may assign credit to invalid or answer-irrelevant steps. We propose Proof-R1, an RL framework from formal verification that trains LLMs to construct verifiable proofs for natural-language logical reasoning. Proof-R1 admits a generated conclusion into the verified proof state only when the corresponding reasoning action satisfies the proof obligations through UNSAT-based machine-checkable formal verification. Proof-R1 also recovers the answer-supporting dependency closure to trace the proof structure of the final answer and align outcome credit with the proof dependencies. Experiments demonstrate that Proof-R1 improves answer accuracy across three logical reasoning benchmarks and four backbone models and outperforms training-free agents and training-based methods in terms of reasoning-process verifiability.
items.summary_zh: Proof-R1 将自然语言逻辑推理训练改造成带形式验证的证明构造任务：只有通过基于 UNSAT 的机器可检验义务检查的结论，才能进入已验证证明状态，并追踪支撑最终答案的依赖闭包。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把“答对”与“证明步骤有效且确实支撑答案”区分开来，提供了可检查的中间步骤和依赖关系；摘要还报告了三个逻辑推理基准、四个骨干模型上的结果。
items.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地用于自然语言逻辑推理，其中最终答案容易检查，但背后的证明并不容易检查。在自然语言逻辑推理中，中间结论应当由其前提推出，而完整推导应当支撑最终答案。现有方法缺乏对中间结论以及支撑答案的证明依赖进行机器可检查的验证，因此可能会给无效步骤或与答案无关的步骤赋予信用。我们提出 Proof-R1，一种来自形式验证的强化学习框架，用于训练 LLM 为自然语言逻辑推理构造可验证证明。只有当相应的推理动作通过基于 UNSAT 的机器可检查形式验证、满足证明义务时，Proof-R1 才会将生成的结论纳入已验证证明状态。Proof-R1 还会恢复支撑答案的依赖闭包，以追踪最终答案的证明结构，并使结果信用与证明依赖相一致。实验表明，Proof-R1 在三个逻辑推理基准和四个骨干模型上提高了答案准确率，并在推理过程可验证性方面优于无需训练的智能体和基于训练的方法。
items.author_line: Qili Zhang, Qianren Mao, Hanze Cai, Kaiming Zhao, Yuening He, Xihan Lei, Yashuo Luo, Hanwen Hao, Yutong Gu, Likang Xiao, Zhijun Chen, Weifeng Jiang, Haoyi Zhou, Jianxin Li

items.title: Probability is Not Enough: Exploring and Counting Divergent Tokens for Reasoning Uncertainty Quantification in LLMs
items.abstract_or_text: As the chain-of-thought reasoning capabilities of large language models improve, evaluating and calibrating their reasoning confidence is becoming increasingly important for quantifying the uncertainty of their answers. Current methods for estimating the confidence of large language models are generally based on probabilities of selected key tokens, but the underlying mechanism remains unclear. Our pilot study finds that replacing selected token probabilities with coarse substitutes can also improve calibration, motivating us to further explore effective signals of model confidence. We introduce Divergent Token Confidence (DTC), a framework that estimates confidence by counting tokens at which two models strongly disagree during decoding. DTC identifies these divergent tokens using the Jensen-Shannon divergence between next-token distributions evaluated along the same reasoning trajectory. We find that their count is almost negatively associated with answer accuracy, thereby serving as a simple yet effective signal for uncertainty quantification. DTC supports both white-box and black-box evaluation using auxiliary models, without explicit training and affecting the generation process. Experiments across multiple model families and six mathematical benchmarks demonstrate improved calibration over probability-based and verbalized baselines. Under white-box evaluation, the count-only estimator achieves an average expected calibration error of 13.0%, compared with 32.7%-42.4% for standard full-sequence confidence methods. In black-box settings, it also improves calibration over the original verbalized scores. For example, mean expected calibration error falls from 32.1%-40.2% to 13.7%-16.3% on DeepSeek-V3.2. These findings provide new insights for improving reasoning uncertainty quantification in large language models. The code is released at https://github.com/szu-tera/DTC.git.
items.summary_zh: Divergent Token Confidence（DTC）通过统计两个模型在同一推理轨迹上下一词分布显著分歧的 token 数量，估计 LLM 推理的不确定性；在六个数学基准上报告了优于概率式和口头置信度基线的校准结果。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它给出了不改变生成过程、可支持白盒和黑盒评估的置信度信号，并用期望校准误差提供了可复核的数学推理可靠性指标。
items.abstract_zh: 随着大型语言模型的思维链推理能力提升，评估并校准其推理置信度对于量化答案不确定性变得越来越重要。当前估计大型语言模型置信度的方法通常基于所选关键 token 的概率，但其潜在机制仍不清楚。我们的初步研究发现，用粗粒度替代量取代所选 token 概率同样可以改善校准，这促使我们进一步探索有效的模型置信度信号。我们提出 Divergent Token Confidence（DTC），一种通过统计两个模型在解码过程中强烈分歧的 token 来估计置信度的框架。DTC 使用沿同一推理轨迹计算的下一 token 分布之间的 Jensen-Shannon 散度来识别这些分歧 token。我们发现，分歧 token 的数量几乎与答案准确率负相关，因此可作为一种简单而有效的不确定性量化信号。DTC 支持使用辅助模型进行白盒和黑盒评估，不需要显式训练，也不影响生成过程。在多个模型家族和六个数学基准上的实验表明，与基于概率和口头表达的基线相比，DTC 改善了校准。在白盒评估中，仅使用计数的估计器取得了 13.0% 的平均期望校准误差，而标准的全序列置信度方法为 32.7%–42.4%。在黑盒设置中，它也改善了相对于原始口头分数的校准。例如，在 DeepSeek-V3.2 上，平均期望校准误差从 32.1%–40.2% 降至 13.7%–16.3%。这些发现为改进大型语言模型的推理不确定性量化提供了新的认识。代码已发布于 https://github.com/szu-tera/DTC.git。
items.author_line: Feiyang Li, Shengjing Liu, Qi Zhan, Sijie Cheng, Weiqing Wang, Hongwen Chen, Yuxuan Yang, Wen Wang, Yile Wang, Hui Huang

items.title: Inducing Process Supervision from Outcome-Only Reinforcement Learning
items.abstract_or_text: Process reward models (PRMs) have become a key component for LLMs, as their step-level feedback supports both post-training and test-time reasoning. However, training strong PRMs remains costly: human step annotation is difficult to scale, while Monte Carlo estimation is computationally expensive and can drift from the intrinsic correctness of steps. To get effective PRMs at low cost, we introduce TIPS (Thinking-Induced Process Supervision), an outcome-only reinforcement learning (RL) framework for training generative PRMs. In TIPS, the model generates a chain-of-thought (CoT) followed by step-level labels and an outcome label. The reward depends solely on whether the predicted outcome matches the ground truth, and the resulting group-relative advantage is used to optimize the entire generated response. Intuitively, when checking intermediate steps helps determine the outcome, more accurate checks can lead to better outcome judgments and higher rewards. Outcome-only RL can therefore reinforce step-level verification without explicit process supervision. We validate the effectiveness of TIPS across math and agent benchmarks and four backbone families. Notably, TIPS-Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 reaches 85.2 F1 on ProcessBench with only 3.2K outcome-labeled trajectories, surpassing all evaluated trained PRMs and strong prompt-only judges such as GPT-5.4-Instruct and Claude-4.7-Opus, while still trailing o1-mini. Code and data are available at https://github.com/RUCBM/TIPS.
items.summary_zh: TIPS 仅使用最终答案是否正确的强化学习信号，训练生成式过程奖励模型同时输出思维链、逐步标签和结果标签；在 ProcessBench 上以 3.2K 条结果标注轨迹取得 85.2 F1。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作检验了能否从低成本的结果监督中诱导出步骤级验证能力，并在数学与智能体基准、四类骨干模型上给出对比结果。
items.abstract_zh: 过程奖励模型（PRM）已成为大型语言模型的重要组成部分，因为其步骤级反馈支持后训练和测试时推理。然而，训练强大的 PRM 成本高昂：人工步骤标注难以扩展，蒙特卡洛估计计算开销大，而且可能偏离步骤的内在正确性。为了低成本地获得有效 PRM，我们提出 TIPS（Thinking-Induced Process Supervision），一种用于训练生成式 PRM 的仅结果强化学习框架。在 TIPS 中，模型生成一条思维链，随后生成步骤级标签和结果标签。奖励只取决于预测结果是否匹配真实答案，并使用由此得到的组相对优势来优化完整生成响应。直观地说，当检查中间步骤有助于判断结果时，更准确的检查会带来更好的结果判断和更高奖励。因此，仅结果强化学习可以在没有显式过程监督的情况下强化步骤级验证。我们在数学和智能体基准以及四个骨干模型家族上验证了 TIPS 的有效性。值得注意的是，使用仅 3.2K 条结果标注轨迹的 TIPS-Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507 在 ProcessBench 上达到 85.2 F1，超过所有被评估的训练式 PRM 和 GPT-5.4-Instruct、Claude-4.7-Opus 等强大的仅提示评判器，但仍低于 o1-mini。代码和数据已发布于 https://github.com/RUCBM/TIPS。
items.author_line: Shengda Fan, Xin Cong, Zhong Zhang, Haotian Chen, Yankai Lin

items.title: Learning to Steer, Steering to See: Unveiling the Geometry of RLVR in Large Language Models via Trainable Vectors
items.abstract_or_text: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a key paradigm for enhancing the reasoning of large language models, yet the high dimensionality of parameter updates makes its training dynamics hard to analyze. We study reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) and use vector steering to identify a low-dimensional effective manifold in activation space associated with RL-induced gains. We uncover two geometric properties. (1) Effective Manifold Capacity: the capacity needed to reproduce RL gains can be very small but is not infinitely compressible; at extremely low capacity, intervention dimensionality and input-dependent expressiveness become key constraints, and this requirement varies with injection depth. (2) Control Manifold Separation: effective control directions lie mainly in the low-variance complement of the activation principal subspace. Within a task and base model, the learned geometry stays largely consistent across training configurations, and across tasks geometric alignment correlates with capability transfer. Experiments on 5 LLMs and 6 verifiable-reward tasks support these findings. We then propose Alpha-Stabler, a plug-and-play framework with a Predictor that monitors principal-subspace intrusion for early collapse warnings, and a Controller that removes the principal-subspace component of activation gradients during backpropagation while preserving the orthogonal complement. Alpha-Stabler stabilizes training for 2,000 steps and consistently improves RL gains, offering practical insights for robust post-training. Code: https://github.com/caiyuchen-ustc/On_Policy_Vector_Training
items.summary_zh: 该工作用可训练向量分析 RLVR 在 LLM 激活空间中的低维有效流形，提出 Alpha-Stabler 监测主子空间侵入并抑制相应梯度，以稳定后训练。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把强化学习推理增益转化为可观测的几何结构，并在 5 个 LLM、6 个可验证奖励任务上提供了跨配置的一致性与训练稳定性证据。
items.abstract_zh: 强化学习已成为增强大型语言模型推理能力的重要范式，但参数更新的高维性使其训练动态难以分析。我们研究带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR），并使用向量引导在激活空间中识别与 RL 诱导增益相关的低维有效流形。我们发现了两个几何性质。（1）有效流形容量：复现 RL 增益所需的容量可能非常小，但并非可以无限压缩；在极低容量下，干预维度和输入相关的表达能力成为关键约束，而且这一需求会随注入深度变化。（2）控制流形分离：有效控制方向主要位于激活主成分子空间的低方差补空间中。在同一任务和基础模型内，学习到的几何结构在不同训练配置间大体一致；跨任务的几何对齐程度与能力迁移相关。我们在 5 个 LLM 和 6 个可验证奖励任务上的实验支持这些发现。随后我们提出 Alpha-Stabler，一个即插即用框架：其中 Predictor 监测主子空间侵入以提前预警坍缩，Controller 在反向传播时移除激活梯度的主子空间分量，同时保留正交补空间。Alpha-Stabler 可将训练稳定在 2,000 步，并持续改善 RL 增益，为稳健后训练提供实践见解。代码：https://github.com/caiyuchen-ustc/On_Policy_Vector_Training。
items.author_line: Yuchen Cai, Ding Cao, Qixiang Yin, Xin Xu, Kai Yang, Siye Wu, Pengyuan Wang, Jiaxuan Wang, Weijie Liu, Saiyong Yang, Guangzhong Sun, Guiquan Liu, Junfeng Fang

items.title: Reasoning with Continuous Latent Diffusion
items.abstract_or_text: Continuous diffusion generates complete reasoning solutions through iterative refinement in latent space. We introduce the Continuous Embedding Diffusion Reasoner (CEDR), an ELF-based training and inference recipe. Our experiments show that accurate decoding alone does not ensure strong reasoning performance. We therefore learn compact representations from multiple layers of a strong autoregressive teacher. Their decomposition also enables asynchronous denoising at different rates. We show that prompt encodings need only preserve the information required for the correct text-conditional score, rather than exactly match teacher features, and use a staged curriculum to learn a compact prompt encoder that replaces the teacher Transformer at inference. We adapt DiffusionNFT to learned self-conditioning guidance and incorporate gold-solution endpoints to supplement sparse rewards. Our supervised models outperform reported results from recent continuous-diffusion baselines at comparable backbone scales on mathematical reasoning and HumanEval code generation. With a 638M-parameter denoising backbone and learned prompt conditioning, post-NFT CEDR-L achieves 63.74% pass@1 on GSM8K and 24.6% on MATH500 at 64 denoising steps, and 32.85% on HumanEval and 30.18% on HumanEval+ at 128 denoising steps. Code will be available at: https://github.com/chengxiang/CEDR.
items.summary_zh: CEDR 研究连续潜变量扩散如何生成数学推理解答，结合教师表征、异步去噪、自条件引导和金标准终点；638M 去噪骨干在 GSM8K、MATH500 和 HumanEval 上报告了具体 pass@1。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它给出了连续扩散推理在数学题和代码生成上的可检验结果，同时提醒仅提高解码准确率并不自动带来更强推理。
items.abstract_zh: 连续扩散通过在潜空间中迭代细化来生成完整推理解答。我们提出 Continuous Embedding Diffusion Reasoner（CEDR），一种基于 ELF 的训练和推理方案。我们的实验表明，准确解码本身并不能保证强大的推理性能。因此，我们从强大的自回归教师模型的多层学习紧凑表示。对这些表示进行分解还支持以不同速率进行异步去噪。我们表明，提示编码只需保留正确文本条件得分所需的信息，而不必精确匹配教师特征，并使用分阶段课程学习训练紧凑提示编码器，使其在推理时替代教师 Transformer。我们将 DiffusionNFT 适配为学习式自条件引导，并加入金标准解答终点以补充稀疏奖励。在相当的骨干规模下，我们的监督模型优于近期连续扩散基线报告的结果，覆盖数学推理和 HumanEval 代码生成。采用学习式提示条件的 638M 参数去噪骨干，在 64 次去噪步数下，后 NFT 的 CEDR-L 在 GSM8K 上达到 63.74% pass@1，在 MATH500 上达到 24.6%；在 128 次去噪步数下，在 HumanEval 上达到 32.85%，在 HumanEval+ 上达到 30.18%。代码将发布于：https://github.com/chengxiang/CEDR。

items.title: Why Deterministic PRM Guidance Underperforms in Discrete Diffusion Reasoning
items.abstract_or_text: Discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs) expose a denoised solution at every step, which makes process reward model (PRM) guidance look like a way to spend compute at test time. We show that once denoising, PRM scoring, and outcome reward model (ORM) scoring are charged in the same budget of forward passes, its deterministic form loses to a much simpler baseline. Our PRMs score intermediate denoising states and are trained on the correctness of the final answer. On Dream-v0-Instruct-7B with 8 candidates per GSM8K problem, keeping the candidate with the highest PRM score at every scoring step reaches 65.18%, while independent sampling plus an ORM reranker trained for the task reaches 75.13%. The gap grows to 12.69 percentage points (pp) with 32 candidates, and is 9.85 pp on MATH and 12.16 pp on MBPP. We trace it to two separable failures. First, guidance prunes on a weak signal: on GSM8K, PRM ROC-AUC falls from 0.77 to 0.54 as the mask ratio rises, a decay that persists when states are relabeled with fresh rollouts, and pruning lowers the best accuracy reachable from the candidate pool from 81.05% for independent samples to 67.30%. Second, on GSM8K and MATH, the PRM is a poor final judge: a sequential Monte Carlo sampler at the same budget restores that ceiling to 77.89%, yet selecting with the PRM gives 65.48%, on par with deterministic guidance, while a PRM retrained on final states matches the ORM on identical candidates. MBPP separates the two: there the PRM reaches 65.47% when reranking finished programs, on par with the ORM, but 50.88% when it guides denoising. The results point to two targets for dLLM guidance: keep correct partial solutions alive through early denoising, and leave the final choice to a verifier trained on final states. We release the corpus of denoising states with outcome labels and evaluation toolkit for reproducible comparisons at matched compute.
items.summary_zh: 论文在统一前向计算预算下比较离散扩散语言模型中的 PRM 引导、独立采样和 ORM 重排，发现确定性 PRM 引导会因早期错误剪枝和终态判别弱而落后。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它不仅报告性能差异，还用 ROC-AUC、候选池上限和重训练对照拆分失败原因，为测试时验证器设计提供了可检验诊断。
items.abstract_zh: 离散扩散语言模型（dLLM）在每一步都暴露去噪后的解答，这使得过程奖励模型（PRM）引导看起来像是在测试时使用计算的一种方式。我们表明，当去噪、PRM 评分和结果奖励模型（ORM）评分都按相同的前向次数预算计费时，其确定性形式会输给一个简单得多的基线。我们的 PRM 对中间去噪状态进行评分，并根据最终答案的正确性进行训练。在 Dream-v0-Instruct-7B 上，对每个 GSM8K 问题生成 8 个候选，若在每个评分步骤保留 PRM 分数最高的候选，准确率为 65.18%；而独立采样加上针对该任务训练的 ORM 重排达到 75.13%。当候选数为 32 时，差距扩大到 12.69 个百分点（pp）；在 MATH 和 MBPP 上，差距分别为 9.85 和 12.16 个百分点。我们将其归因于两个可分离的失败。第一，引导在弱信号上进行剪枝：在 GSM8K 上，随着掩码比例上升，PRM ROC-AUC 从 0.77 降至 0.54；即便用新生成的轨迹重新标注状态，这种衰减仍然存在，而且剪枝会把候选池中可达到的最高准确率从独立采样的 81.05% 降至 67.30%。第二，在 GSM8K 和 MATH 上，PRM 是一个较差的最终评判器：同样预算下，序贯蒙特卡洛采样将这一上限恢复到 77.89%，但使用 PRM 选择后准确率为 65.48%，与确定性引导相当；而在相同候选上重新训练、针对最终状态的 PRM 可达到与 ORM 相当的效果。MBPP 将两者区分开来：在对完成的程序重排时，PRM 达到 65.47%，与 ORM 相当；但在引导去噪时只有 50.88%。这些结果指出，dLLM 引导需要解决两个目标：在早期去噪中保留正确的部分解答，并把最终选择留给针对最终状态训练的验证器。我们发布了带结果标签的去噪状态语料和评估工具包，以便在匹配计算预算下进行可复现实验。
items.author_line: Yan Zhan, Shaobo Liu, Zhijun Gao

items.title: Pass or Fail? Evaluating LLMs on Two Greek Examination Benchmarks
items.abstract_or_text: The rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs) imposes a thorough evaluation of their linguistic and analytical capabilities as well as constraints, particularly for a language with limited benchmark coverage such as Greek. To address the limited availability of comprehensive benchmarks in this domain, we introduce Prot-Ex and Pan-Ex, two benchmarks consisting of questions from entrance exams for Greek Model and Experimental schools as well as the Panhellenic exams (the Greek national university entrance examinations). These benchmarks are employed to assess the performance of text-only LLMs-including the Greek-adapted KriKri-8B-Instruct, Llama-3.1-8B, Gemma-4-26B, and Qwen-3-32B-across diverse academic disciplines (Modern Greek, Mathematics, Physics, etc.) and task formats (closed, structured, and open-ended), including textualized visual context (i.e., image descriptions). Our findings indicate the localized KriKri-8B significantly outperforms its base model, successfully rivalling much larger LLMs in linguistically demanding humanities tasks. By leveraging an LLM-as-a-Judge methodology, we expose the inadequacy of traditional lexical metrics for evaluating complex reasoning. Crucially, we uncover a few-shot prompting paradox: while synthetic examples improve accuracy in closed-ended questions, they severely overload the context window of 8B models in structured tasks, causing significant performance degradation. Ultimately, this study suggests targeted linguistic adaptation offsets lower parameter counts in specialized domains, despite the fragility of smaller models to prompt verbosity.
items.summary_zh: Prot-Ex 和 Pan-Ex 用希腊入学考试题评测文本 LLM 在现代希腊语、数学、物理等学科和多种题型上的能力，并分析语言适配、LLM-as-a-Judge 与提示长度的影响。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它提供了覆盖数学与结构化开放题的区域化评测，显示词汇指标不足以衡量复杂推理，也揭示少样本示例可能使小模型在结构化任务中退化。
items.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）的快速发展要求全面评估其语言和分析能力及其局限，尤其是对于基准覆盖有限的语言（如希腊语）。为应对该领域综合基准不足的问题，我们提出 Prot-Ex 和 Pan-Ex 两个基准，题目来自希腊模范学校和实验学校的入学考试以及 Panhellenic 考试（希腊全国大学入学考试）。我们使用这些基准评估纯文本 LLM，包括适配希腊语的 KriKri-8B-Instruct、Llama-3.1-8B、Gemma-4-26B 和 Qwen-3-32B，覆盖现代希腊语、数学、物理等不同学科以及封闭式、结构化和开放式等题型，其中还包括文本化的视觉上下文（即图像描述）。研究结果表明，本地化的 KriKri-8B 在语言要求较高的人文学科任务上显著优于其基础模型，并成功匹敌规模大得多的 LLM。通过采用 LLM-as-a-Judge 方法，我们揭示传统词汇指标不足以评估复杂推理。我们还发现了一个少样本提示悖论：合成示例能提高封闭式问题的准确率，却会严重耗尽 8B 模型在结构化任务中的上下文窗口，导致性能显著下降。总体而言，这项研究表明，针对性语言适配可以抵消较小参数规模在专门领域中的劣势，但较小模型对提示冗余仍然脆弱。
items.author_line: Panagiota Kyriazi, Eleni Kasoura, Prokopis Prokopidis

items.title: Diagnosing and Improving Probabilistic Reasoning in Large Language Models
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly proposed as decision assistants who must reason probabilistically from available evidence under explicit decision costs. We propose a decision-theoretic framework that decomposes LLMs' decision loss into two components: forming accurate beliefs from provided evidence and translating those beliefs into actions that optimize a provided utility function. Using a synthetic benchmark with known ground truth, we apply the decomposition to characterize probabilistic reasoning in frontier and open-sourced models. We further evaluate whether RL interventions targeting beliefs, decisions, or both improve these components across three domains, whether improvements transfer across components and elicitation formats, and whether decision performance can improve without improvement in belief formation. We find that targeting one component of probabilistic reasoning redistributes decision loss, improving the target without necessarily transferring to others, and that jointly targeting belief formation and decision-making improves both but hinges on matched formats between training and evaluation.
items.summary_zh: 工作以具有已知真值的合成基准分解 LLM 概率推理损失，区分证据到信念的形成与信念到行动的决策，并测试分别或联合进行 RL 干预的迁移性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这种分解能检验模型是不会形成正确信念，还是不能把信念转成效用最优行动，避免只用最终决策分数推断推理能力。
items.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被提议作为决策辅助系统，需要根据可用证据在明确决策成本下进行概率推理。我们提出一个决策理论框架，将 LLM 的决策损失分解为两个部分：根据所提供证据形成准确信念，以及将这些信念转化为能够优化给定效用函数的行动。我们使用具有已知真实值的合成基准，对前沿模型和开源模型中的概率推理进行刻画。我们进一步评估在三个领域中，针对信念、决策或两者的 RL 干预是否能改善这两个部分，改进是否能跨部分和跨诱导格式迁移，以及决策性能能否在信念形成没有改善的情况下提升。我们发现，针对其中一个部分会重新分配决策损失：目标部分得到改善，但不一定迁移到另一部分；同时针对信念形成和决策进行训练可以同时改善两者，但其效果取决于训练和评估格式是否匹配。
items.author_line: Huaman Sun, Dingcheng Wang, Jason Hartline, Jessica Hullman

items.title: RESCUE: Repairing Language Model Errors to Sparse Circuits via Reinforcement Learning
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong general capabilities that mechanistic interpretability has attributed to sparse computational circuits. However, existing circuit studies emphasize preserving functionality or explaining safety, leaving the mechanisms underlying failures across a broader range of tasks largely unexplored. Extending circuit analysis from abilities to errors, we explore the perspective that such failures may likewise arise from erroneous internal computations and that targeted tuning of the corresponding parameters can correct such errors while largely preserving other capabilities. Motivated by this insight, we introduce RESCUE (Reasoning-Error Sparse-Circuit Uncovering and Editing), a framework that localizes error-associated circuits and surgically repairs them for performance enhancement. General tasks typically involve multi-step reasoning and long-form generation, where early deviations can cause prefixes to drift from supervised references, leading SFT-based mask optimization to overlook circuits involved in generation-time errors. RESCUE therefore refines these masks through reinforcement learning with multiple masked-model rollouts, improving their relevance to observed task failures. Finally, RESCUE introduces a pruning technique and precisely fine-tunes error circuits to correct task failures, thereby translating error localization into a sparse and targeted model update. We validate RESCUE on heterogeneous repair sets across two domains: (1) mathematical reasoning, identifying a math error circuit of 1.40% density whose repair raises accuracy from 6.0% to 75.5%; and (2) medical QA, where a similarly compact 1.44% circuit improves repair-set accuracy from 0% to 81%. Our code is available at: https://github.com/chuanpupig/RESCUE.
items.summary_zh: RESCUE 用强化学习定位与推理错误相关的稀疏电路，再进行有针对性的参数修复；摘要报告数学推理修复集准确率从 6.0% 提升到 75.5%，医疗问答从 0% 提升到 81%。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把模型错误定位与局部修复连接起来，并给出电路密度、修复前后准确率等可检验指标，但结果仍限于摘要所述修复集。
items.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）表现出很强的通用能力，机制可解释性研究已将其归因于稀疏计算电路。然而，现有电路研究主要强调保持功能或解释安全性，对于更广泛任务中失败的机制探索仍然有限。我们将电路分析从能力扩展到错误，提出这样一种观点：这些失败同样可能源于错误的内部计算；通过针对相关参数进行调优，可以在基本保持其他能力的同时纠正错误。基于这一思路，我们提出 RESCUE（Reasoning-Error Sparse-Circuit Uncovering and Editing），一种定位与错误相关电路并进行手术式修复以提升性能的框架。一般任务通常涉及多步推理和长文本生成，其中早期偏离会使前缀偏离监督参考，因此基于 SFT 的掩码优化可能忽略生成时错误所涉及的电路。RESCUE 因此通过多次掩码模型 rollout 的强化学习来细化这些掩码，使其更贴近实际观察到的任务失败。最后，RESCUE 引入剪枝技术，并对错误电路进行精确微调，以修复任务失败，从而把错误定位转化为稀疏且有针对性的模型更新。我们在两个领域的异质修复集上验证 RESCUE：（1）数学推理，识别出密度为 1.40% 的数学错误电路，其修复将准确率从 6.0% 提高到 75.5%；（2）医疗问答，其中密度为 1.44% 的类似电路将修复集准确率从 0% 提高到 81%。代码已发布于：https://github.com/chuanpupig/RESCUE。
items.author_line: Chuanpu Liu, Miao Yu, Yikai Cai, Yuanhe Zhang, Zhenhong Zhou, Li Sun, Zuming Jiang, Yufei Guo

items.title: Teach to Learn: Hint Annealing for Self-improving LLM Reasoning
items.abstract_or_text: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) improves language-model reasoning by comparing verified rewards among multiple solution rollouts for each query. However, difficult training queries can yield only incorrect rollouts, leaving GRPO with no reward contrast or learning signal. Prior hint-based methods construct auxiliary hints from solution evidence and use them to re-solve failed queries, recovering learning signal. Yet the resulting trajectories are typically treated as ordinary solution trajectories despite being generated under an assisted condition unavailable at evaluation. We discover hinted reward shift: recovered reward contrast can concentrate policy updates on hinted trajectories, limiting improvement without hints. This also creates a trade-off: increasing hinted trajectories can accelerate early learning but intensify reward shift later. To address this problem, we propose HATCH (Hint-Annealed Self-Teaching), an online single-policy framework that learns from both generating and using its own hints to improve reasoning without assistance. To mitigate hinted reward shift, we introduce online weighting to anneal the contribution of hinted trajectories. However, learning to generate hints can conflict with improving query solving. We therefore use gradient projection to remove the opposing component of hint-generation updates. Together, these designs support self-improvement by enabling the policy to create learning opportunities for itself and turn them into stronger reasoning without hints. We evaluate our method on mathematical reasoning benchmarks and outperform state-of-the-art methods by 1.02 pp on Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct, 2.84 pp on Qwen3-1.7B, and 4.32 pp on Qwen3-8B.
items.summary_zh: HATCH 针对 GRPO 在困难题上缺少奖励对比的问题，让策略在线生成并使用提示，同时通过权重退火和梯度投影减轻提示奖励偏移；在多个数学基准上取得增益。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它明确区分有提示训练轨迹与无提示评测条件，给出不同模型规模上的百分点提升，适合观察自我改进是否真正迁移到无辅助推理。
items.abstract_zh: 组相对策略优化（GRPO）通过比较每个查询的多次解答 rollout 中经过验证的奖励来改进语言模型推理。然而，困难训练查询可能只产生错误 rollout，导致没有奖励对比或学习信号。以往基于提示的方法从解答证据构造辅助提示，并用这些提示重新解决失败查询，从而恢复学习信号。但由此得到的轨迹通常被当作普通解答轨迹处理，尽管它们是在评估时不可获得的辅助条件下生成的。我们发现了提示奖励偏移：恢复的奖励对比可能把策略更新集中到带提示轨迹上，从而限制没有提示时的改进。这还形成了一种权衡：增加带提示轨迹可以加速早期学习，但会在后期加剧奖励偏移。为解决这一问题，我们提出 HATCH（Hint-Annealed Self-Teaching），一种在线单策略框架，使模型从生成和使用自身提示两方面学习，在没有外部辅助的情况下改进推理。为减轻提示奖励偏移，我们使用在线加权来退火带提示轨迹的贡献。然而，学习生成提示可能与改进问题求解发生冲突。因此，我们使用梯度投影移除提示生成更新中相互冲突的分量。综合这些设计后，策略能够通过为自身创造学习机会并将其转化为更强的无提示推理来实现自我改进。我们在数学推理基准上评估该方法，相比最先进方法，在 Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct、Qwen3-1.7B 和 Qwen3-8B 上分别提高 1.02、2.84 和 4.32 个百分点。
items.author_line: Zile Wang, Zijian Li, Haodong Wang, Jian Liu, Qianli Liu, Lucas Muli, Blaze Chen, Song Guo

items.title: MetaCtrl: Your Large Language Models Can Reason Better and More Concisely with a Metacognitive Controller
items.abstract_or_text: Large reasoning models improve performance on challenging problems by allocating additional computation before answering, but longer reasoning does not always lead to better results and can introduce substantial redundant reasoning on simple problems. Conversely, aggressively shortening reasoning can degrade performance on difficult ones. Effective reasoning therefore requires dynamically deciding when additional computation is useful based on the reasoner's capabilities and evolving solution state. Existing approaches often rely on predefined budgets or intervention rules, retrain the target reasoner, or require additional supervision. We introduce MetaCtrl, a lightweight controller that adaptively regulates a frozen reasoner without predefined token budgets or reasoner retraining. We formulate reasoning regulation as a sequential metacognitive control problem: MetaCtrl observes the evolving reasoning trace and decides whether to continue, simplify, skip redundant steps, or conclude reasoning. It is trained directly with reinforcement learning using a reward that prioritizes correctness while favoring shorter trajectories among correct solutions, requiring neither supervised intervention trajectories nor problem-specific budgets. Across seven benchmarks spanning mathematics, science, and code, MetaCtrl consistently improves the accuracy of LRMs while reducing their reasoning length. On DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, it improves average accuracy by 4.7 points while reducing generation length by 53.3%. Without further training, the same controller transfers to an unseen reasoner (e.g., Qwen3-14B), improving average accuracy by 2.9 points and reducing generation length by 50.3%. These results establish MetaCtrl as a plug-and-play controller for improving reasoning accuracy while substantially reducing inference-time generation. The code is available at https://github.com/binbin2xs/MetaCtrl.
items.summary_zh: MetaCtrl 是不重新训练推理器的轻量控制器，将继续、简化、跳过冗余步骤或结束推理建模为序贯元认知控制；在七个数学、科学和代码基准上提高准确率并减少推理长度。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它同时报告正确率、推理长度和跨推理器迁移，能检验“更长思维链”是否真的带来更好结果，而不是只追求更多 token。
items.abstract_zh: 强大的推理模型通过在回答前分配额外计算来提升困难问题上的性能，但更长的推理并不总是更好，而且可能在简单问题上引入大量冗余推理。相反，过度缩短推理可能会降低困难问题上的性能。因此，有效推理需要根据额外计算是否有用以及解答状态如何变化来动态决定是否继续计算。现有方法通常依赖预定义预算或干预规则，需要重新训练目标推理器，或需要额外监督。我们提出 MetaCtrl，一个无需预定义 token 预算或重新训练推理器、即可自适应调节冻结推理器的轻量控制器。我们将推理调节形式化为序贯元认知控制问题：MetaCtrl 观察不断生成的推理轨迹，并决定继续、简化、跳过冗余步骤或结束推理。它直接通过强化学习训练，奖励在优先保证正确性的同时偏好更短的正确轨迹，不需要监督式干预轨迹或特定问题预算。在覆盖数学、科学和代码的七个基准上，MetaCtrl 持续提高 LLM 推理器的准确率，同时减少推理长度。在 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B 上，它将平均准确率提高 4.7 个百分点，并将生成长度减少 53.3%。无需进一步训练，同一控制器还能迁移到未见过的推理器（例如 Qwen3-14B），将平均准确率提高 2.9 个百分点，并将生成长度减少 50.3%。这些结果表明，MetaCtrl 是一种即插即用的控制器，能够提高推理准确率并大幅减少推理时生成。代码：https://github.com/binbin2xs/MetaCtrl。
items.author_line: Zhibin Wen, Tao Han, Lei Bai, Can Li, Yang Xu

items.title: Solver Agent: an Agentic AI Framework for Theoretical Physics Computations Applied to F-theory Uplifts of O3-planes and S-folds
items.abstract_or_text: We introduce Solver Agent, an AI framework based on large language models for calculations and proofs in mathematics and theoretical physics. The solution process is tracked through a persistent ledger that records assumptions, derivations, and computations. A central agent delegates tasks to specialized sub-agents, while independent agents verify both intermediate steps and the final result. This setup improves the traceability, reproducibility, and verification of computer-assisted calculations. Applying Solver Agent, we study global F-theory uplifts of Type IIB orientifolds and their S-fold generalizations. We establish sufficient conditions for Weierstrass models over projective threefolds with terminal Z_k quotient singularities (k\in\{2,3,4,6\}) to give Q-factorial projective elliptically fibered Calabi-Yau fourfolds with isolated Gorenstein terminal quotient singularities. These geometries realize O3-planes and S-folds, where local D3-brane probes of the latter yield four-dimensional N=3 superconformal field theories. Using stringy invariants, we derive fixed-point contributions to Hodge data and Euler characteristics, and show that these Euler corrections determine the localized D3-brane charges required for tadpole cancellation. We illustrate these results using toric hypersurface constructions, where a single three-dimensional polytope determines both the Type IIB Calabi-Yau threefold and the F-theory base; here, the orientifold double cover naturally forms a bisection of an alternative genus-one-fibered uplift with discrete Z_2 gauge symmetry. Finally, we provide methods for toric computations and four-form flux analysis in four-dimensional N=1 compactifications with non-abelian gauge sectors.
items.summary_zh: Solver Agent 用持久化账本记录假设、推导和计算，由中央智能体分派专门子任务，并让独立智能体验证中间步骤与最终结果；应用于 F-theory 中 O3-plane 和 S-fold 的 uplift 计算。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是候选中少数直接面向数学与理论物理计算、并把审计轨迹和独立校验纳入工作流的智能体框架；其结论仍应按摘要所述的充分条件和示例理解。
items.abstract_zh: 我们介绍 Solver Agent，一种基于大型语言模型、用于数学和理论物理计算与证明的 AI 框架。解答过程通过持久化账本进行跟踪，账本记录假设、推导和计算。一个中央智能体将任务分派给专门子智能体，同时由独立智能体验证中间步骤和最终结果。这种设置提高了计算机辅助计算的可追踪性、可复现性和可验证性。我们将 Solver Agent 应用于研究 Type IIB 轨形的全局 F-theory uplift 及其 S-fold 推广。我们为带有终端 Z_k 商奇点（k∈{2,3,4,6}）的射影三维簇上的 Weierstrass 模型，建立其成为具有孤立 Gorenstein 终端商奇点的 Q-factorial 射影椭圆纤维化 Calabi-Yau 四维簇的充分条件。这些几何实现了 O3-plane 和 S-fold，其中后者的局部 D3-brane 探针产生四维 N=3 超共形场论。利用弦论不变量，我们推导 Hodge 数据和 Euler 示性数中的不动点贡献，并表明这些 Euler 修正确定了潮汐抵消所需的局域 D3-brane 电荷。我们用 toric 超曲面构造说明这些结果：单个三维多面体同时确定 Type IIB Calabi-Yau 三维簇和 F-theory 底空间；定向双覆盖自然形成另一种带离散 Z_2 规范对称性的亏格一纤维化 uplift 的二截面。最后，我们给出四维 N=1 紧化中带非阿贝尔规范扇区的 toric 计算和四形式通量分析方法。
items.author_line: Eliott Morgensztern, Cesar Fierro Cota, Alessandro Mininno

items.title: On the Limits of Metacognitive Monitoring in LLMs
items.abstract_or_text: Reliable decisions depend on recognizing when an answer may be wrong. In biological cognition, metacognitive monitoring can dissociate from task performance, raising the question of how closely solving and judging are linked in language models. Here we study the confidence reports of four frontier models across 15 benchmarks. High task accuracy can coexist with weak error discrimination: a model solves 97% of competition mathematics problems while its answer-time confidence ranks correct answers above errors barely better than chance. Confidence separates correct answers from errors more effectively on questions solved by a separate reference model, while review brings limited improvement on reference-hard questions. Aggregate discrimination also rewards ranking correct answers on easy questions above errors on hard ones, which question-only forecasts already do well. Cross-evaluation helps most where the evaluator answered correctly, and errors shared by the two models usually retain high confidence. Hard questions and shared errors remain difficult targets for prompted self-review and peer oversight, even in models with strong problem-solving performance.
items.summary_zh: 该研究在 15 个基准上考察四个前沿模型的置信度监控，发现高任务准确率可以与近乎随机的错误区分能力并存，且共享错误往往仍保持高置信度。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它直接检验模型能否识别自身错误，提醒不能把高解题率或自我复核表现简单等同于可靠的元认知监控。
items.abstract_zh: 可靠的决策依赖于识别答案可能出错的时刻。在生物认知中，元认知监控可以与任务表现脱钩，这引出了一个问题：语言模型中的解题与判断究竟有多紧密。我们在 15 个基准上研究四个前沿模型的置信度报告。高任务准确率可以与较弱的错误区分能力并存：某个模型能够解决 97% 的竞赛数学题，但其在回答时的置信度将正确答案排在错误答案之前的能力仅略高于随机水平。当问题由另一个参考模型解决时，置信度对正确答案和错误答案的区分更有效；而对于参考模型也难以解决的问题，复核带来的改进有限。总体区分能力还会把“简单问题上的正确答案”排在“困难问题上的错误答案”之前，而仅依赖问题的预测本身就能较好地做到这一点。当评估模型自己答对时，交叉评估最有帮助；两个模型共享的错误通常仍保持高置信度。困难问题和共享错误仍是提示式自我复核与同伴监督难以处理的目标，即使模型本身具有很强的解题表现。
items.author_line: Dongqi Han, Yifan Yang, Dongsheng Li

items.title: Improving Large Language Models for Code through Runtime Program-State Reasoning
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models receive limited explicit training in reasoning about runtime program states. We study whether training models to reason about runtime program states improves downstream software-engineering capabilities. We introduce two complementary program-state reasoning tasks. Buggy input-output reasoning requires a model to generate a concrete input that exposes a behavioral difference between a buggy program and a hidden correct implementation and to predict the resulting execution behavior. Precondition-postcondition reasoning requires an agent to symbolically characterize a bug-triggering precondition, predict the expected postcondition, explain their causal connection, and instantiate this reasoning as an executable regression test. By incorporating these two tasks into a staged post-training pipeline, we develop Comet-9B, a 9B language model based on Qwen3.5-9B Base. We evaluate the resulting checkpoints on repository-level patch generation, regression-test generation, and security PoC generation. Adding both program-state reasoning tasks to supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on issue resolution improves success rates by 7.25 percentage points on SWE-bench Pro and 9.70 points on SWT-Bench Verified. Sequential reinforcement learning on the two tasks yields further gains of 7.25, 26.79, and 4.67 percentage points on SWE-bench Pro, SWT-Bench Verified, and CyberGym, respectively. Despite having only 9B parameters, Comet-9B achieves a score comparable to the reported GPT-5.2 result on SWE-bench Pro and matches the reported success rate of a GPT-4o-based agent on SWT-Bench Verified.
items.summary_zh: Comet-9B 增加运行时程序状态推理训练，包括构造触发 bug 的输入、预测执行行为、推导前置—后置条件并生成可执行回归测试；在 SWE-bench Pro、SWT-Bench Verified 和 CyberGym 上报告增益。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作把程序状态、因果连接和可执行测试作为可检验推理任务，连接了形式化式验证思路与软件工程模型能力评测。
items.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型在运行时程序状态推理方面接受的显式训练有限。我们研究，训练模型推理运行时程序状态是否能改善其下游软件工程能力。我们提出两个互补的程序状态推理任务。带缺陷的输入—输出推理要求模型生成一个具体输入，以暴露有缺陷程序与隐藏的正确实现之间的行为差异，并预测由此产生的执行行为。前置条件—后置条件推理要求智能体符号化刻画触发缺陷的前置条件、预测预期后置条件、解释二者的因果联系，并将该推理实例化为可执行回归测试。通过把这两个任务纳入分阶段后训练流程，我们开发了 Comet-9B，一个基于 Qwen3.5-9B Base 的 9B 语言模型。我们在仓库级补丁生成、回归测试生成和安全概念验证生成上评估训练所得检查点。在问题解决上，对两个程序状态推理任务进行监督微调（SFT）使 SWE-bench Pro 的成功率提高 7.25 个百分点，使 SWT-Bench Verified 提高 9.70 个百分点。在这两个任务上进行顺序强化学习后，SWE-bench Pro、SWT-Bench Verified 和 CyberGym 的成功率又分别提高 7.25、26.79 和 4.67 个百分点。尽管只有 9B 参数，Comet-9B 在 SWE-bench Pro 上取得了与报告中的 GPT-5.2 结果相当的分数，并在 SWT-Bench Verified 上达到了基于 GPT-4o 的智能体所报告的成功率。
items.author_line: Hongwei Li, Spandan Garg, Yufan Huang

items.title: GenLimitLib: A Formal Library for Language Generation in the Limit and AI-Assisted Mathematical Research
items.abstract_or_text: We present GenLimitLib, a source-aligned Lean 4 library for language generation in the limit. Introduced by Kleinberg and Mullainathan at NeurIPS 2024, language generation in the limit studies a theoretical question motivated by LLMs: how to generate valid new strings from observed examples. This young and rapidly evolving field offers a natural testbed for studying large-scale formalization. GenLimitLib contains formal developments for 30 papers. It extracts shared definitions and reusable proof components while preserving paper-specific assumptions and statements, and records relationships across papers. In this way, GenLimitLib provides a concrete and structured view of the literature. We show through mathematical case studies and LLM experiments how our library can support both human mathematical research and AI-assisted research. Our Library: https://github.com/pengzhang91/generation-in-the-limit-lib.
items.summary_zh: GenLimitLib 是与来源对齐的 Lean 4 形式化库，收录“language generation in the limit”领域 30 篇论文的定义、可复用证明组件和论文间关系，并用数学案例和 LLM 实验展示其研究辅助价值。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把新兴理论文献系统地转成可检查、可复用的 Lean 资源，为证明助手和 AI 辅助数学研究提供了明确的形式化资产。
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出 GenLimitLib，一个与来源对齐的 Lean 4 语言极限生成形式化库。由 Kleinberg 和 Mullainathan 在 NeurIPS 2024 引入的 language generation in the limit 研究一个受 LLM 启发的理论问题：如何从观察到的示例中生成有效的新字符串。这一年轻且快速发展的领域为大规模形式化提供了自然试验场。GenLimitLib 包含 30 篇论文的形式化发展成果。它提取共享定义和可复用证明组件，同时保留各论文特有的假设和陈述，并记录论文之间的关系。通过数学案例研究和 LLM 实验，我们展示了该库如何支持人类数学研究和 AI 辅助研究。我们的库：https://github.com/pengzhang91/generation-in-the-limit-lib。

items.title: HeurEvo: Agentic Evolution of Hybrid Solver-Augmented Heuristics for Time-Critical Mathematical Optimization
items.abstract_or_text: Recent advances in agentic heuristic design use AI agents and execution feedback to automate algorithm discovery for challenging optimization problems. In many practical settings, high-quality solutions must be obtained under strict runtime constraints, motivating hybrid approaches that combine problem-specific heuristics with powerful mathematical programming solvers. However, existing approaches typically improve heuristic components within predefined procedures or tune solver configurations in isolation. This limits holistic adaptation of where to allocate computation, how to leverage solvers, and how to refine the overall algorithmic structure. To address these limitations, we propose HeurEvo, an automated plan--code--component co-evolution framework that jointly evolves the high-level algorithmic structures, their implementations, and a shared pool of reusable components. A planner determines which algorithmic components to use, how to combine them, and how to allocate runtime across stages, a coder realizes the resulting plan as executable code, while a component evolver updates the shared component pool. Within an island-based evolutionary framework, plans and implementations co-evolve with feedback from an interpreter agent that analyzes execution results and identifies opportunities for improvement. Across diverse combinatorial optimization benchmarks and challenging MIPLIB instances, HeurEvo finds high-quality solutions within tight runtime budgets, often matching or surpassing state-of-the-art optimization solvers given hours or days of computation. On several nonlinear geometry problems such as hexagon packing, it also improves upon the best previously reported results. These results highlight the value of jointly searching over algorithmic structure and implementation for agentic heuristic design.
items.summary_zh: HeurEvo 让规划器、代码器和组件池在岛模型进化框架中共同演化，并依据执行反馈改进算法结构、实现和计算分配；在组合优化、MIPLIB 和六边形装箱等任务上报告结果。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把智能体的数学优化能力落到可执行算法和运行时间约束上，评测不只看答案，还涉及求解器质量、预算和具体优化实例。
items.abstract_zh: 近期的智能体启发式设计进展使用 AI 智能体和执行反馈，自动化发现用于困难优化问题的算法。在许多实际场景中，需要在严格运行时间约束下获得高质量解，这促使人们采用将问题特定启发式与强大数学规划求解器结合的混合方法。然而，现有方法通常只在预定义流程中改进启发式组件，或孤立地调节求解器配置。这限制了对计算资源分配位置、求解器使用方式以及整体算法结构的综合适应。为解决这些限制，我们提出 HeurEvo，一个自动化的计划—代码—组件共同进化框架，联合演化高层算法结构、其实现以及可复用组件的共享池。规划器决定使用哪些算法组件、如何组合它们以及如何在各阶段分配运行时间；代码器将所得计划实现为可执行代码；组件进化器更新共享组件池。在基于岛模型的进化框架中，计划和实现根据解释器智能体对执行结果的分析以及其识别出的改进机会共同进化。在多种组合优化基准和具有挑战性的 MIPLIB 实例上，HeurEvo 能在严格运行时间预算内找到高质量解；在给出数小时或数天计算时间的情况下，它常常达到或超过最先进优化求解器的结果。在若干非线性几何问题（如六边形装箱）上，它还改进了此前报告的最佳结果。这些结果说明，在智能体启发式设计中联合搜索算法结构和实现具有价值。
items.author_line: Feijie Wu, Hugo Barbalho, Konstantina Mellou, Marco Molinaro, Jing Gao, Ishai Menache, Xinzhi Zhang, Sirui Li
